notes: SearXNG "403 Forbidden" root cause correction: — the 403 was incorrectly attributed to `searchdns: true`. The actual cause: SearXNG's default `search.formats` only allows `html`, but the app requests `format=json`, which SearXNG rejects with 403 by design. All Help docs (EN/AR/ARZ), Settings description, and the in-app log message now correctly instruct users to add `json` to `search.formats` in `settings.yml`. The previous `-e SEARXNG_DNS__SEARCH_DNS=false` advice has been removed.
